description_en: Queries the checkpoints of a shard from which data is consumed by a consumer group
description_zh: 调用GetCheckPoint接口获取指定消费组消费数据时Shard的checkpoint
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-check-point --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --consumer-group consumer-group-1 --shard 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCheckPoint

parameters.description_en: The name of the consumer group.
parameters.help_en: The name of the consumer group
parameters.name: consumer_group

parameters.description_en:
The shard ID.

- If the specified shard does not exist, an empty list is returned.

- If no shard ID is specified, the checkpoints of all shards are returned.
parameters.description_zh:
Shard ID。

- 如果指定的Shard不存在，则返回空列表。
- 如果不指定Shard，则返回所有Shard的Checkpoint。
